summary: Owner renewed the Agrippa/Münchhausen challenge to explanatory regress. Materialized/read the complete pinned Latta Monadology §§31–45, separating §32 universal explanatory scope and epistemic limitation, §§33–35 analytical termination, §§36–37 renewed contingent-detail demand and §45 proposed intrinsic existence reason. Existing unique-feedback, history-contrastive and regress fixed-point certificates already cover the formal omission tests; no duplicate theorem or opaque adequacy predicate is added. Leibniz argues against leaving the whole contingent sequence explained only by further contingent details, not against infinity as a cardinal or against every beginningless history. The independently disputed premises are whole-series PSR, the inadequacy of an undischarged contingent explanation-base, and the exclusion of intrinsic global/non-well-founded accounts. A brute global fact, a complete structural account and a non-well-founded ground account are separate positive rivals. Neither necessity nor a reason-token alone certifies the proposed necessary ground’s sufficiency. See the explanatory-adequacy audit in docs/notes/unique-feedback-explanation-311.md for exact argument steps, theorem locators, rejected readings and remaining bridges. Intended/actual root-premise delta zero; no premise established, no source-free per se causal impossibility inferred.
